privacy: This policy explains how Green Leaves | JNRM Corporation handles information submitted through the PURE website.

We collect the details needed to serve you: your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, optional map pin, order contents, discounts, and order history. Google sign-in provides a verified email address and account identifier. We also use essential cookies and browser storage to keep guest sessions, carts, rewards, and sign-in working. We count anonymous shop visits and product opens to understand which items interest visitors. Metrics use a random browser-tab identifier that is hashed by day; we do not store names or IP addresses for these counts.
Process, confirm, deliver, and support orders.
Send order confirmations, courier details, and status updates.
Prevent duplicate orders, misuse, and unauthorized access.
Maintain customer rewards and improve the store.

We share only the information necessary with providers that help operate the store, such as delivery couriers, email providers, website infrastructure, and payment providers when online payments are enabled. We do not sell customer information.

We keep order records for business, accounting, fraud-prevention, and legal purposes. Session data expires or is removed when no longer needed. We use access controls and secure connections, but no internet service can promise absolute security.

You may ask to access, correct, or delete eligible personal information. Some order records may need to be retained for legal or accounting requirements. You can also check out as a guest where available.

returns: Tell us promptly when a direct website order arrives damaged, incorrect, missing, or defective.
Contact us through WhatsApp with your order number, a description of the issue, and clear photos of the item, parcel, label, and packaging. Keep the item and packaging while we review the request.

Depending on the circumstances and applicable law, we may arrange a replacement, complete missing items, issue a refund, or offer another appropriate remedy. We may need to inspect the item or ask for additional information.

For safety and hygiene, a change of mind may not qualify once a sealed food product has been opened. This does not limit remedies for defective, damaged, incorrect, or misrepresented goods under applicable law.

Contact us as soon as possible. Pending or Confirmed orders may be cancelled before dispatch when preparation or courier handoff has not made cancellation impractical. Shipped orders must follow the issue-review process.
Approved refund timing depends on the original payment method and financial provider. For cash-on-delivery orders, we will agree on a practical refund method with you.
shipping: How direct PURE website orders are confirmed, dispatched, and tracked.

New orders begin as Pending. Once availability and delivery details are checked, the order moves to Confirmed. We may contact you before dispatch when an address, phone number, stock item, or delivery arrangement needs clarification.

Delivery availability depends on your location and the couriers serving it. The delivery fee displayed at checkout applies to the order. If a rate is unavailable, checkout will ask you to contact us before ordering.
Delivery dates are estimates until a courier accepts the shipment. Weather, peak periods, address issues, and courier operations may cause delays. We will share updated information when available.
When a courier and tracking number are assigned, they appear in your PURE account. Signed-in customers can open Tracking; guest customers may contact us with their order number.
Check the parcel and items promptly. If an item is damaged, incorrect, or missing, keep the packaging and contact us with your order number and clear photos.
terms: These terms apply to direct purchases placed through the PURE website.

Submitting an order sends a purchase request. We confirm availability and delivery arrangements before dispatch. We may contact you when details need clarification or an item becomes unavailable. Keep your contact information accurate so we can reach you.

Prices are shown in Philippine pesos. The checkout total includes configured delivery charges and applicable discounts. Cash on delivery is available. When online payment is enabled, card and GCash payments are processed on the PayMongo hosted checkout. An order is marked paid only after payment confirmation from PayMongo; returning to this website alone does not confirm payment.
We work to keep photos, descriptions, prices, and stock accurate. Packaging may change. Always read the product label for ingredients, allergens, directions, and storage requirements before use.

Scratch rewards are subject to the displayed promotion rules, availability, minimum spend, and discount cap. A qualifying returning-customer benefit may apply after a completed direct order. Discounts cannot be combined unless the checkout says they can.

Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with ordering, or submit fraudulent information. We may reject or cancel orders linked to abuse, obvious pricing errors, unavailable stock, or delivery locations we cannot serve.
Nothing in these terms removes rights provided by applicable Philippine consumer law. Our Shipping and Returns policies form part of these terms.
